description: Machine-readable live work queue. Passing entries are retained for 24 hours, then removed by pnpm features:prune; durable behavior and evidence remain in product specs and Git/PR history. See docs/FEATURES.md for rules.

features.behavior: DataGrip-style grid editing across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB: single-click whole-cell selection; double-click/Enter/F2 inline editing for scalar values; shared Add row, Duplicate row, staged delete, JSON operation/SQL statement preview, and Commit bar; BSON-preserving MongoDB field updates with stable hexadecimal ObjectId row keys, optimistic conflict guards, and validated regex, timestamp, code, MinKey, and MaxKey JSON editors; shared True/False boolean and enum selectors; lossless date, time, time-with-time-zone, timestamp, and PostgreSQL interval editing; automatic dismissal of any active scalar, structured, or inserted-row editor when another body cell is clicked; compact right-side drawer editing for JSON, supported arrays, binary hex, XML, and intervals, with visible Format/Minify/Copy and fixed actions; grouped binary hex with byte count and ASCII preview under a friendly bytes label; binary values normalized to hex when duplicating rows; plain-text JSON/array substring filters on SQL engines and native structured containment on MongoDB; validated PostgreSQL bit-string and network editing; anchored SET editing with optional full-panel expansion; spreadsheet keyboard navigation, typed copy/paste, nullable clearing, undo, staged dirty-state feedback, and page-level commit; automatic catalog/row refresh after successful writes; fixed-width truncated columns; adaptive icon-only shell tabs and row actions below the desktop breakpoint; and a non-executing SQL Explain action with no Analyze control.

features.evidence: Draft PR #160 (https://github.com/ensp1re/qyre/pull/160), round 8 pushed as bdf2667, round 9 as c74d70a, round 10 as 148d4b7, round 11 as 6bd5276, and rounds 12-16 as b06a89d. Rounds 3-16 live-review refinements include true whole-cell selection/editing, stable long-text geometry, shared typed scalar/structured/binary editors, lossless temporal and interval handling, SQL substring filters, immediate post-write refresh, and MongoDB's replacement of the separate whole-document drawer with the same Add/Duplicate/edit/delete/Commit grid used by SQL. MongoDB operations preview JSON, update changed fields through `$set`, preserve existing BSON types, reject same-field concurrent edits using original-value guards, and author regex, timestamp, code, MinKey, and MaxKey through validated JSON drawers with Add-row templates. Round 14 normalizes ObjectIds to stable lowercase hex across BSON package instances and safely accepts the `$oid` wire form. Round 15 additionally accepts only the exact legacy 12-byte buffer payload retained by an already-open pre-fix browser page. Round 16 commits the live input value on blur so fast click-away cannot drop the final scalar edit. Rebuilt production browser checks pass in MongoDB and PostgreSQL; server tests pass 309/309 and UI tests pass 421/421. The Node 22 local and pre-push `pnpm verify:pr` gates pass with 34/34 package tasks, check:state, smoke E2E (11 passed, 4 skipped), and full E2E (30 passed, 47 skipped) across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB. Both GitHub jobs fail before any steps because the repository's Actions credits are exhausted.

features.behavior: Provide one compact, accessible control and typed-editor system for Qyre's write workflows: shared Button, IconButton, Field, Select/Combobox, and editor actions; lossless text, multiline, exact numeric/decimal, identifier, tri-state boolean, enum/set, date/time/timestamp, JSON/JSONB, supported-array, and MongoDB Extended JSON editors; explicit validation and before/after feedback; and explained read-only treatment for binary and unknown values. Preserve authoritative permission, --read-only, server-validation, driver, and transaction behavior across PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB.

features.evidence: Draft PR #159 (https://github.com/ensp1re/qyre/pull/159), pushed as fc57253. Added compact shared Button, IconButton, Field, custom Select/Combobox, and editor-action primitives; lossless typed text, exact numeric, identifier, boolean, enum/set, temporal, JSON/JSONB, supported-array, and MongoDB structured editors; authoritative PostgreSQL enum/array and MySQL enum/set metadata; and server validation that preserves permission/read-only/transaction gates. features.behavior: Protect SQL row-editing integrity and make scalar activation predictable: define a mutation-specific editor capability matrix; fail closed for time and timestamp values until a lossless editor is verified; keep exact temporal values display-only; make row-background clicks select while editable cell controls activate consistently by pointer, Enter, or F2; and keep scalar editors overlaid so activating them does not resize rows or columns. Preserve permission, --read-only, transaction, and cross-engine behavior; MongoDB remains on its document editor.

features.evidence: Merged PR #158 (https://github.com/ensp1re/qyre/pull/158), pushed as a6330fa. Added a mutation-specific editor capability matrix, failed closed for time/timestamp values the previous minute-only control could not round-trip, made scalar editing activate consistently by click/Enter/F2, restored focus on Escape, separated cell actions from row selection, and overlaid editors without changing grid geometry. Focused core, UI, and web suites passed (69, 371, and 148 tests); UI/web typechecks and builds passed; focused writable/read-only E2E passed. Live Postgres verification at 1440, 1024, and 768px confirmed unchanged 29.25px row geometry, no page overflow, no console errors, F2 activation, Escape focus restoration, and no row selection from cell activation. Full local and pre-push pnpm verify:pr passed (34/34 package tasks, 11 smoke E2E passed/4 expected skips, 29 full E2E passed/43 expected skips).

features.behavior: Audit Qyre's complete web experience before changing production code: exercise first-use and returning-user flows, all four engines, writable/read-only/restricted sessions, dense data, destructive and recovery states, keyboard/accessibility behavior, light/dark themes, and responsive desktop widths; record evidence-backed findings, systemic causes, and an approval-gated product-wide polish plan with bounded implementation slices and acceptance criteria.
features.evidence: Draft PR #157 (https://github.com/ensp1re/qyre/pull/157), pushed as c24b1b3. Completed a live, evidence-backed audit across all four engines, writable/read-only/restricted sessions, both themes, dense and failure states, and 320-1440px widths; captured 35 screenshots and recorded 23 findings. User review triggered a deeper editing audit that confirmed conflicting selection/edit gestures, unstable Add/Commit UI, missing structured editors and shared controls, redundant writable status, and a critical minute-only temporal mutation fidelity risk. The user approved the revised nine-slice plan. Verified with pnpm verify:pr locally and through pre-push (34/34 package tasks, 11 smoke E2E passed/4 expected skips, 29 full E2E passed/43 expected skips); both GitHub CI jobs passed.
